head: 108f375bcd2c3e94c20d93dd619d641b6386b352
scope: Prompt Kanban detail-loading stability, virtual row spacing, localized preview labels, list checkbox alignment, and favorite-button focus
rootCause: The board subscribed to the full detail cache and prefetched all missing details on cache updates. A 116-item list exceeded the 100-entry cache, allowing eviction/refetch feedback and whole-board commits.
changes: Load detail through mounted cards using the existing detail hook; retain loaded body during eviction.
End loading when a detail arrives through the shared cache; show explicit failure and retry.
Measure virtual rows including spacing; share card geometry through a CSS property.
Fit three columns in the 832px fixture, localize preview labels, avoid nested scrollbars in regular cards.
Align list checkbox and body columns; remove remount entrance/size animations.
Keep stable footer action identity so favorite changes retain keyboard focus.

regression.boundary: Real React UI and Zustand store, mocked IPC transport and bounded virtualizer viewport. Counts cover the Kanban component, not full-app native FPS or pixel layout.
